_README: REAL EXTRACTION - TRANCHE 6. COMPLETENESS RE-EXTRACTION driven by the full 236-paragraph sweep.
Closes the gaps in LOI_clause_completeness_report.md. Source: LOI_US__7_30_2026_.docx v1.
Clauses marked _topup add MODIFIERS to clauses already loaded - do not recreate the clause.
Clause marked _resource is a SOURCE CORRECTION (audit_right: ecdt -> national-template-drop).
1. trash_recycling BASE clause (para 148) - the TR0/TR1/TR2 ladder had nothing to modify.
TR0/TR1/TR2 must be RE-KEYED from alternatives to modifiers riding this base.
2. exclusive_use VIOLATION REMEDY (para 91, '[FOR ALL LEASES]') - always emits; without it the
exclusive was being emitted with no enforcement mechanism at all.
3. LETTER SHELL - the document frame; the assembler could not produce an LOI without it.
4. audit_right re-sourced and gated to buildings of three tenants or fewer.
STILL BLOCKED (unchanged): R0/R1 rent schedules and LCW0/LCW1/LCW2 primaries.
EXCLUSION CANDIDATE: the two pylon-panel signage variants (existing vs to-be-constructed) are
mutually exclusive - feed into loi_clause_exclusion when it is built.

canonical_bodies.body_text: In the event any Force Majeure Event, act by Landlord or act of any governmental authority having jurisdiction over Tenant’s use of the Premises restricts or otherwise limits Tenant’s business operations in the Premises and (i) reduces Tenant’s gross sales for any month of the Term by twenty five percent (25%) or more, then Tenant shall pay fifty percent (50%) of the Monthly Base Rent in lieu of Base Rent each month until such restrictions or limitations are lifted, or (ii) Tenant ceases operations in the Premises, then Tenant shall pay no Base Rent {{param:arp_ceased_rent}} of Base Rent], but shall continue to pay Annual Additional Rent. The “Alternative Rent Period” shall run from the date the restrictions or limitations are imposed until the date such restrictions or limitations are lifted.

parameters.note: If Tenant ceases operations: preferred is no Base Rent; template fallback is 25% of Base Rent.

canonical_bodies.body_text: Tenant shall provide Landlord notice of its election to apply the foregoing rent adjustments for the Alternative Rent Period. For a rent adjustment pursuant to clause (i) above, upon Landlord’s written request, Tenant shall provide reasonable documentation of the decline gross sales for the months covered by the Alternative Rent Period.

Any existing tenant as of the date of this Letter of Intent and identified by Landlord in this LOI whose lease allows it to sell any of the foregoing products (Landlord shall include use provisions for each such tenant) will not be subject to Tenant’s exclusive. Landlord agrees that, to the extent that it has reasonable control over such tenant’s use and changes in use, it will exercise such control to enforce Tenant’s exclusive.

Anchor tenants occupying 20,000 contiguous square feet or more and full-line grocery store tenants occupying 10,000 contiguous square feet or more will not be subject to Tenant’s exclusive items so long as the anchor tenants at all times occupy and operate out of the foregoing minimum contiguous square footage under a single trade name, do not have a separate entrance or exterior signage for the sale of Tenant’s exclusive items, or otherwise advertise, in a manner visible from the exterior of such tenant’s space, the sale of Tenant’s exclusive items.

Full service, sit-down restaurants with a wait staff and table service serving a complete dinner menu may sell, in conjunction with a sale of a meal, brewed coffee, tea, and hot espresso drinks for on-premises consumption only.

In the event of a violation of Tenant’s exclusive use or use identified on Exhibit N, all rent due under the Lease shall be reduced by fifty percent (50%) {{param:eu_remedy}}, until the violation has been cured and the competing tenant(s) at the Property cease the sale of any of the products protected by Tenant’s exclusive use described above or the use identified on Exhibit N has ceased operation. In the event that the violation continues for more than 90 days, Tenant shall have the right to terminate the Lease, and shall be entitled to reimbursement by Landlord of the unamortized amount of Tenant’s improvements to the Premises as of the effective date of the early termination of the Lease.

parameters.note: Source offered two remedies: 50% rent reduction (in the base sentence) OR percentage-rent election in lieu of all rent. Second option carries its own rate fill.

options.option_value: or: Tenant shall have the option to pay percentage rent of ___ percent (__%) of Tenant's gross sales from the Premises, in lieu of all rent payable under the Lease

clauses.title: Early Termination
clauses.description: ETR is OMITTED on every Oculus deal by standing decision (current Starbucks field direction, notwithstanding handbook text). Bodies are seeded so the library is complete and so Phase 2 can match a landlord-proposed ETR, but the default emits the placeholder, not the clause.
clauses.guidance_note: Handbook makes ETR exit strategy (2). Oculus never requests it. Absence of an ETR triggers director + store development VP + Real Estate Committee approval per handbook - recorded as a STANDING acknowledged deviation, not a per-deal flag. NEVER emitted.

positions.internal_note: STANDING DEFAULT: emits the placeholder text, not the clause. Douglasville and Powder Springs both render 'Intentionally Deleted'. An omitted clause and a clause marked deleted read differently to a landlord - the placeholder is deliberate.
positions.deviation_rationale: Handbook requires an ETR as exit strategy (2). Current Starbucks field direction is not to ask; asking causes harm. Oculus standing position is omission. Approval trigger recorded once as a standing deviation rather than firing per deal.

positions.internal_note: The actual ETR language. Never selected under the standing default; retained for library completeness and Phase-2 redline matching if a landlord proposes an ETR.
